title: There's a Problem with my New Elves Aero Frame

takeaways.text: The distributor said the Falath and Vanyar frames were being upgraded for UCI approval, with tests passed and paperwork pending; the creator paused his build to test the new frame instead.
The distributor says Elves owns its factory and moulds, with research and development in Taiwan and manufacturing in China, and launched its own brand in 2016 after about ten years of OEM work.

disclosure: The creator bought this Falath frame himself; in this video the Australian Elves distributor offers him a prototype of the upgraded frame, which he later received, as he disclosed in January 2023.
summary: A September 2022 update in which the Australian Elves distributor says the Falath frame the creator bought is being upgraded for UCI approval, with an amateur club official's view of whether that matters.
